none: PAS NLM-ADA2E3: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Muckton
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]NV[--]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing left holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Possible mintmark: III in right field. Diameter: 19.3mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 12
